entries.logic: Automatically identifies and deletes local branches that have already been integrated into the main branch.
entries.implementation: git branch --merged | grep -v "\*" | xargs -n 1 git branch -d
entries.rationale: Keeps the local development environment lean and prevents naming collisions.

entries.logic: Checks for uncommitted changes and mandatory SSQLM headers before allowing a release build.
entries.implementation: [[ -z $(git status --porcelain) ]] || echo "❌ Error: Dirty working tree"
entries.rationale: Ensures that every compiled binary corresponds to a specific, immutable commit hash.
